title: Fabricating of the dual-sited Cu doped Co3O4 on Nickel Foam (Cu-Co3O4/NF) for segmentally efficient electrochemical nitrate reduction under low conductivity
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00462D, Paper
Xueqi Tao, Shuaishuai Man, Qun Yan, Dimitri Vayenas, Athanasia Tekerlekopoulou, Bin Huang
To tackle the removal of low-concentration nitrate contamination, this work utilizes electrocatalytic reduction technology to effectively convert nitrate into recoverable ammonia, using as-prepared Cu doped Co3O4 on Nickel Foam (Cu-Co3O4/NF)...
